# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work, a single worker or station's timeline; steps within a track are chained and never overlap, and any work that happens in parallel to something else lives in a separate track. A **step** is an atomic task with exactly one duration model: `fixed` (a single known number of seconds), `variable` (a range with a default for planning), or `indefinite` (runs until manually stopped, with a default for preview). A **startTrigger** anchors a step to absolute time (`programStart`, `programStartOffset`) or to another step's completion (`afterStep`, `afterStepWithBuffer`), to user action (`manual`), or to conditions like step abort or compound logic. **stepIds must be globally unique** across the entire program, not scoped to a track. Every `task` that appears on a step must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry, and that entry's `maxConcurrent` enforces the physical limit — one oven, one lighting desk, two burners — so two steps claiming the same task can't run together if `maxConcurrent` is 1. Repeated work — n trays baking, n samples processing, n trucks unloading — is declared once with `replicates: {count: n, mode: ...}` on a single step, never as n separate copied steps; downstream steps that run once per instance use `instances: "each"` on their afterStep trigger, steps that wait for all instances use `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area (a cooling rack, a rotor, a dock) only fits k items at once, `maxInFlight: k` throttles the upstream step so instances don't pile up waiting downstream.

---

**Expected resource constraints:**

| Task | maxConcurrent | Crew / notes |
|------|---|---|
| dock | 1 | One loading dock; trucks queue |
| stage | 1 | One stage; all rigging, backline, soundcheck use it sequentially |
| lighting_desk | 1 | One person at the desk; focus and cue-build are strictly sequential |
| pa_rig | 1 | One PA system; fly and ring-out sequential |
| monitor_rig | 1 | One monitor world; setup and ring-out sequential |
| green_room | 1 | Shared holding area; band dinner |
| house_prep | 1 | Front-of-house setup, cleaning, walk-up (one FOH manager or coordinator) |

Crew size: 8 people. No explicit per-step crew assignment given in source; the schedule is task-driven (dock availability, stage availability, desk availability) rather than people-driven.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "dock", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one loading dock; sequential truck unloading" },
    { "task": "stage", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one stage; bars rigging, PA fly, monitors, backline, soundcheck all sequential" },
    { "task": "lighting_desk", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one desk; focus and cue-build strictly sequential" },
    { "task": "pa_rig", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one PA system; fly and ring-out sequential" },
    { "task": "monitor_rig", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one monitor world; setup and ring-out sequential" },
    { "task": "backline_rig", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one backline on stage at a time" },
    { "task": "green_room", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one green room; band dinner holding area" },
    { "task": "house_prep", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "FOH setup, cleaning, walk-up, door call" },
    { "task": "band_soundcheck", "maxConcurrent": 1, "notes": "one soundcheck window on stage" }
  ],
  "actors": 8
}
```
